chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Ibrahim ibn Ahmad al-Mu'addab narrated to us. He said: Abu al-Husayn Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Abi Bishr narrated to me. He said: Al-Husayn ibn al-Haytham narrated to us from Sulayman ibn Dawud al-Minqari. He said:
Whenever Ali ibn Ghurab narrated to us from Ja'far ibn Muhammad, he would say: The Truthful One about Allah, Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him), narrated to us.

key_terms.الصادق: Al-Sadiq: The Truthful One, the title given to Imam Ja'far ibn Muhammad (AS), the sixth Imam
key_terms.عن الله: About/from Allah: indicating that the Imam's truthfulness derives from God's authority

ai.seo_question: Why was Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq called "the Truthful One about Allah"?
ai.summary: This narration describes the practice of Ali ibn Ghurab, a Kufan hadith transmitter, who would give Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) the title "al-Sadiq 'an Allah" (the Truthful One about/from Allah) whenever he narrated from him. This was recorded in a teaching assembly (majlis) held by al-Shaykh al-Saduq on Tuesday, the 18th of Safar, 368 AH. The title highlights the narrator's reverence for the Imam and reflects the scholarly practice of honoring one's teachers with titles of distinction.

en.bilal-muhammad: Al-Husayn b. Ibrahim b. Ahmad al-Mu’addab narrated to us. He said: Abu’l Husayn Muhammad b. Ja`far al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Abi Bishr narrated to me. He said: Al-Husayn b. Haytham narrated to us from Sulayman b. Dawud al-Minqari.  He said:
Whenever `Ali b. Ghurab narrated to us from Ja`far b. Muhammad, he would say: The truthful about Allah (al-sadiq `an Allah) Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) narrated to us.
